lines.en: - The doorknob came off! - Why'd you pull off the doorknob?
'Cause I wanted it for my knob collection!
Because I just don't see what's funny about Fred.
Well, it's not my faulty quiz.
Hey, you don't have to call me names.
Oh, yeah? Well, you're a bigger one!
- Who was that? - My Aunt Jennifer.
Bad thoughts lead to bad actions.
Robbie is in love with me!
So? Freddy's in love with me!
If you're so in love with Sam,
then why have you been running around Los Angeles fa-doodling with Kat?
You could've if you wanted to!
You probably do a lot of sit-ups.
I got to tell you something.
You're gonna tell me that there was no bad luck?
That Sam did all that stuff to me?
Well, I didn't know when it was my pink shorts and my laptop,
but I saw her loosening the bolts on my bike.
But I thought your bike fell apart while you were riding it.
Nope. I just pretended on that one.
- So you're not gonna try to get her back? - You mean, do something devious,
like send her a fake text message
that looks like it came from Gary Wolf,
telling her to meet him at the Crown Ridge Mall?
I didn't know you could be so bad.
You're not supposed to have earth food in here.
Give me some of that meat slam!
- Give me the meat! - No, no, no, no, no, no, no!
Oh, what did they put in the sasinia to make it so incredible?
Uh, look, I don't want to start an argument,
but you might want to finish chewing, you know, before you talk.
What, is this pick on puck at night?
I said I don't want to start an argument.
Carly, is it wrong to tell a person that it's not polite
to talk with a mouth full of lasagna?
Is it wrong for a person to constantly pick on every little thing I do?
- Are you gonna fire that dumb intern? - You mean court?
I'll fire my feminine idiot when you fire your him-becile!
Um, I watched you and iCarly the other night.
Did you like what you saw?
We sort of dated for a while.
She is lazy and a criminal and a nuisance and she has terrible table manners.
He's still in love with me.
And if you think that she is a good employee who deserves to be my boss,
then you, my friend, are a terrible manager
and you don't deserve to have me work here.
Guess what they're serving in the cafeteria tomorrow.
It will be a long time.
It will be a long time.
You were singing the wrong lyrics again.
You were gonna humiliate us in front of everyone.
It's not my fault Sam booked us a gig.
It's your fault we're in a fake band.
Our genius intern just murdered my laptop!
Now can we fire that artichoke?
